__meta__.name: BMG · Price Hypothesis
__meta__.description: Fall-2025 BMG canonical materials; enrollment-weighted section price midpoints and same-ISBN prices. Tests whether 2-year (especially public) students face higher course-material prices. The top card preserves the commissioned enrollment-weighted estimator over each section's required_price_avg midpoint, including own-enrollment and winsorized sensitivity measures. The same-item card isolates price differences for identical books; the third card reports section-weighted price medians, and the Top-125 extract supports review. Canonical Course Materials Use items define the material population; enrollment_assigned drives weighting.
